original.value: Create a cinematic dark anime action illustration of {argument name="character name" default="a young blonde female operative"} vaulting over a tall chain-link security fence topped with barbed wire during a heavy nighttime rainstorm. Set the scene at {argument name="location" default="a guarded military compound"} with a dark watchtower on the left, glowing square floodlights, wet metal railings, distant industrial silhouettes, and a stormy cloud-filled sky. es.value: Crea una ilustración de acción de anime oscuro y cinematográfico de {argument name="character name" default="una joven agente rubia"} saltando sobre una cerca de seguridad alta de malla ciclónica rematada con alambre de púas durante una intensa tormenta nocturna. de.value: Erstelle eine filmreife, düstere Anime-Action-Illustration von {argument name="character name" default="einer jungen blonden Agentin"}, die während eines nächtlichen Starkregens über einen hohen Maschendrahtzaun mit Stacheldrahtkante springt. it.value: Crea un'illustrazione d'azione in stile dark anime cinematografico di {argument name="character name" default="una giovane agente bionda"} che scavalca un'alta recinzione di sicurezza in rete metallica sormontata da filo spinato durante un forte temporale notturno.
